requiredChecks.description: Consumer uses safe labels from safe-label-mapping.json.
Consumer keeps a visible warning that counts are not final facts.
Consumer does not rename eventCount or aggregate total to deaths, kills, confirmed deaths, death events, or final deaths.
Consumer does not join these fields with player identity rows or inferred identities.
Consumer does not create per-event or match timeline outputs from these counts.
Consumer does not create killer/victim/assist or objective attribution.
Consumer does not use these outputs as canonical facts, match facts, or final source facts.
Consumer reads only committed compact summary/artifact JSON, not .dem files.
Consumer does not execute parser, emission runner, recovery, skip, or diagnostics.
Consumer does not emit new death_validation.json or other replay artifact classes.
